name: next-steps
description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts above the input. Press 1, 2 or 3 to put one in the prompt box as a draft you can edit, 0 to dismiss.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

transcriptNotice.title: Also list suggestions in the transcript
transcriptNotice.description: On the desktop app, also write the suggestions into the chat as notice lines. Off by default; the panel already shows them.
